79:1: By those who pull out with violence.
79:2: By those who draw out gently.
79:3: And by those who swim, with a swimming.
79:4: Then by those who race ahead.
79:5: By those who arrange the affair.
79:6: That Day, the shaker will shake.
79:8: On that Day, hearts will tremble.
79:10: They say: Are we truly to be returned to the former state?
79:11: When we have become decayed bones?
79:12: They say: That, then, is a harmful return.
79:13: Whereas it is only a single shout.
79:14: So they are in a flat place.
79:15: Has the narration of Moses come to you?
79:16: When his Rabb called out to him in the sacred valley Tuwa.
79:17: Go to Pharaoh, surely he has transgressed.
79:18: Say: Is there a desire for you to purify yourself?
79:19: And let me guide you to your Rabb so that you may fear.
79:20: So he showed him the greatest sign.
79:23: Then he gathered and called out.
79:24: He said: I am your most exalted Rabb.
79:25: Thereupon Allah seized him with the punishment of the Hereafter and the world.
79:26: Surely in this there is indeed a lesson for whoever fears.
79:27: Are you more difficult in creation, or the heaven that He built?
79:28: He raised its ceiling and arranged it.
79:29: He darkened its night and brought out its forenoon.
79:30: And after that He spread out the earth.
79:31: He brought forth from it its water and its pasture.
79:32: And He made the mountains firm.
79:33: As a provision for you and for your animals.
79:35: The Day when man will remember what he strove for.
79:36: Hell is shown to whoever sees.
79:40: As for the one who feared the station of his Rabb and forbade the soul from lusts,
79:41: Surely Paradise, that is the abode.
79:42: They ask you about the Hour, when is its anchoring?
79:43: In what state are you regarding its reminder?
79:44: Its finality is to your Rabb.
79:45: You only warn whoever fears it.
79:46: The Day they see it, as if they had stayed only an evening or its morning time.
